module: SAP NW SSO 2.0 Secure Login Library Crypto Kernel
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: SAP NW SSO 2.0 Secure Login Library Crypto Kernel v2.0.0.1.32 is a shared library, i.e. it consists of software only. SAP NW SSO 2.0 Secure Login Library Crypto Kernel provides an API in terms of C++ methods for key management and operation of cryptographic functions.
